limitations: hook_s is only populated where beats exist; timing-fallback-only codes are excluded. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Scatter of hook duration (seconds, from the first beat(s) tagged hook/hook_extension) against robust_z.
title: Hook length vs performance
